package.name: wcp_worker
package.description: Worker Context Protocol (WCP) v0.1 reference ROS 2 plugin. Implements the worker side of the nine WCP RPCs (capabilities/list, capabilities/subscribe, tasks/post, tasks/claim, tasks/execute, tasks/attest, tasks/settle, tasks/supervise, tasks/abort) and bridges to Nav2 BehaviorTree for transport, ROS 2 lifecycle for plugin state, and WebRTC for graded-autonomy supervision handoff.
